reference_title: Soil Stabilization and Modification for Pavements

figures.caption: Gradation Triangle for Aid in Selecting Commercial Stabilizing Agent
figures.description: Triangular gradation chart entered with percent passing the No. 200 (0.075 mm) sieve and percent material between the No. 4 (4.75 mm) and No. 200 sieves; the intersection gives an area designation (1A, 1B, 1C, 2A, 2B, 2C, 3) used to look up candidate stabilizing additives in Table 2-3 (table_2_3_additive_selection_guide). Chart read-off, not digitized numerically.

figures.caption: Example Standard Curve for Spectrophotometer
figures.description: Standard curve of spectrophotometer transmission reading vs. sulfate (SO4) concentration in parts per million, used in the Appendix A-3.2 turbidimetric sulfate determination to convert a measured transmission reading into a ppm concentration (see equations.equation_turbidimetric_percent_so4). Chart read-off, not digitized numerically.
